description: Source code for remote cluster message sending service in Mattermost, including functions for broadcasting and sending messages asynchronously to remote clusters, handling HTTP communication, and managing callbacks.

classes.name: sendMsgTask
classes.description: Represents a task to send a message to a remote cluster, including the target remote cluster, message, and callback function.

methods.name: BroadcastMsg
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message to all remote clusters interested in the message's topic.

methods.name: SendMsg
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a message to a specific remote cluster.

methods.name: sendMsg
methods.description: Handles the actual sending of a message task when dequeued from the send channel.

methods.name: sendFrameToRemote
methods.description: Performs HTTP POST to send a message frame to a remote cluster with timeout and error handling.
